reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for removal of impacted cerumen procedures when 
• 
Reported with an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code that supports the necessity for performing 
the procedure. 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
Procedures reported for removal of impacted cerumen are submitted with any other ICD-
10-CM diagnosis that does not support the necessity for performing the procedure. 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT code(s), ICD-10-CM 
code(s) and/ or HCPCS Codes reported.
